title: Song Of Ice And Cogs
description: Bigger, better, medieval loocking, and more realistic (excluding the magic, dragons, dungeons, and flying vilages i guess).
body:
Dragons, trains, foundries, floating islands, incredible mountain ranges and even player built and usable ships, planes, tanks or whatever you can think off!

-- Read Disclaimer below before downloading --

## ♦ Features
This modpack brings better world gen, new biomes, structures, sound effects, mobs (both cute and deadly), background noises, music, bosses, villages, dungeons, tech, magic, house decoration, gliders, food and much more.
- Look out for **Dragons**. They are incredibly dangerous and will smell you from a mile away. Same as nukes, if from your position they look bigger than a thumb, RUN.
- New beautiful music and sounds sistems by [Reactive Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/reactive-music), [Sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound) and [Sound Physics Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered)
- Yes, i said **ships** up there. With the glorius [Valkirien Skies](https://modrinth.com/mod/valkyrien-skies) and [Clockwork](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-clockwork) you can create **moving, floating ships** and **vehicles**. So living life at sea in your ship is now posible.
  Clockwork allows for many more posibilities and types of vehicles, but if you want an easier way to get them going feel free to swap it for [Eureka!Ships!](https://modrinth.com/mod/eureka), wich offers a simpler but more limited way to build them. _(The ship in the images is built with this)_
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric) (pun intended) machine sistems to automate factories and power your creations. Go from a small workshop to a train powered factory.
- Build a foundry with [Tinker's Construct](https://modrinth.com/mod/hephaestus) to melt your metals and make powerful tools and weapons.
- Become a nomad in the desert and carry your stuff like medieval merchant with [NiftyCarts](https://modrinth.com/mod/niftycarts). Or take to the skies, jumping from tower to tower with [Paragliders](https://modrinth.com/mod/paragliders).
- Give hunt to the new bosses brought by [Aquamirae](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquamirae), [Bosses Of Mass Destruction](https://modrinth.com/mod/bosses-of-mass-destruction)
- Explore a new dimension, the Otherside from [Deeper And Darker](https://modrinth.com/mod/deeperdarker).
- Make your way through the improved nether thanks to [BetterNether](https://modrinth.com/mod/betternether) and [Incendium](https://modrinth.com/mod/incendium)
- Experience a new way to get to **The End** with [End Remastered](https://modrinth.com/mod/endrem) and try your luck finding the rare [Lost Castle](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-lost-castle)
- Explore the new End from [Better End](https://modrinth.com/mod/betterend) and fight it's now more powerful End Dragon
- Beautify your home with decorations, plants and furniture. And cook deliciuos foods to get buffs before a fight
- Like half a dozen structure mods to make exploring interesting.
- And many many more things, but this is getting too long.  

  Oh, and make sure to photograph it all with [Exposure](https://modrinth.com/mod/exposure)
###  ⚠ Warning
**This is a pretty heavy pack, so make sure to have at least 10GB of RAM  assigned.**

If experiencing invisble beds or chests it may be caused by Enhanced Block Entities mod. Should fix itself when disabling optimizations for that block in the mod options.

Make sure to try out [Do a Barrel Rol](https://modrinth.com/mod/do-a-barrel-roll) before throwing youself into the void with the elytras, as it changes the fliying mechanics

## 🚩DISCLAIMER
Due to licensing, i can`t repackage some texturepacks not found on Modrinth, please make sure to also download these texture packs from CurseForge:
- [Excalibur | Ice and Fire](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/ice-and-fire-excalibur) 
- [Excalibur | Ice and Fire | Tabla's Dragon Retextures](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur-ice-and-fire-tablas-dragon-retextures) 
- [Excalibur | End Remastered Support](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur-end-remastered-support) 
- [Excalibur | Deeper and Darker Support](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur-deeper-and-darker-support) 
- [Excalibur | Traveler's Backpack Support](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur-travelers-backpack-support) 
- [Excalibur | [Let's Do] Vinery Support](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur-lets-do-vinery-support) 
- [Excalibur | Apotheosis Support](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur-apotheosis-support/files/all?page=1&pageSize=20&showAlphaFiles=hide) 

For this last one you`ll have to rename some things, but it's really easy don't worry, explanation below.

<details>
<summary>Renaming Apotheosis Support to work with Zenith</summary>

To make it work, all references to **"apotheosis" must be changed to "zenith"**. Sounds long but it's really quick. You'll just need **Notepad++**, **VS Code**, or something similar. You could use the deafult notepad, but you'd have to go file by file renaming everything.

First, extract the .zip file and chage the folders inside assets from "apotgheosis" to "zenith".

Then, open the folder in your editor, and Find & Replace "apotheosis" for "zenith" on all files. 

Inside now assets/zenith/models/block make sure "bookshelf_apotheosis.json" has changed to "bookshelf_apotheosis.json".

And done. Enjoy the pack my friend :)

</details>

## 📖 Resource Pack Load Order ##
<details>
<summary>💡 Recommended Load Order for Best Compatibility:</summary>

- Defaults (froms mods and vanilla)
- Semos Animation Lib
- Excalibur
- Excalibur | Clarent Edition (Clarent)
- Fresh Animations 
- Freshly Modded (FMRP)
- Excalibur | Fresh Animations (EFA)
- Everything else

There should be a folder in the selection screen with all extensions, you just have to order them once selected.

</details>



## ⚙ Optional and performance stuff 

Make sure to check out [ServerCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/servercore)'s  explained config options [here](https://github.com/Wesley1808/ServerCore/blob/main/docs/config/DEFAULT.md) to squeeze out more performance if you need it. And [Vanilla Refresh](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanilla-refresh)'s many changes (not so many, but you may like or dislike some).

I meant for this pack to be as immersive as it is fun, so there is also a thirst and body heat system. If fighting the elements isn't your thing, just remove [EnviromentZ](https://modrinth.com/mod/environmentz) and [Dehydration](https://modrinth.com/mod/dehydration) from the pack. For those that want it in, make sure to set **Bonus Chest** to **On** in world gen and/or to focus on getting a **leather flask** to hold your water and a **copper cauldron** to purify water at the start.

The pack was made with [Excalibur](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/excal) in mind for it's mod compatibility packs, but i've thrown in Embrace Pixels and Create Ultra for those who may prefer some PBR and Alacrity as another alternative. Feel free to remove everything but Sparkles and Fresh Animations if you want vanilla textures or to free up RAM usage.

There are various shaders included, choose to your liking. I recommend using any of them with cloud shadows enabled, but for those that won't/can't use them, Nuit has some beautiull skyboxes, give it a look. 

Feel free to remove or substitute [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) for more performance, although world gen is beautiful enough to be worth it. **Lowering** the **distance** and **CPU usage** should be enough for most though.
